bodyHtml:
MEGA-130 High-Pressure Booster Tank

130-Liter (34 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-130 is an essential pressurized water system component designed for high-rise buildings, fire systems, and demanding long-distance pressure support. With a total volume of 130 liters (34 gallons), it provides reliable water pressure at a consistent, set level.

 

Built for high-stress environments, this tank supports a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. To ensure stable performance and prevent fluctuations caused by temperature changes, it is factory pre-charged with 100% nitrogen gas.

 

Measuring 55.0 cm in diameter and 77.9 cm in height, the tank includes a heavy-duty base for added stability. It is an ideal high-capacity solution for residential and commercial booster setups requiring exceptional high-pressure performance and flow rates.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-130 is a 130-liter (34-gallon) high-performance diaphragm tank, engineered as the premier solution for mid-sized water system stabilization. Utilizing a specialized FDA-grade polypropylene liner integrated with a premium butyl diaphragm, it ensures a dedicated "Safe Water Zone" by preventing any contact between the liquid and the tank’s metallic shell.

Key technical advantages include a 100% Nitrogen pre-charge and a 16-bar (232 PSI) pressure rating, which significantly outperforms standard industry tanks. This configuration ensures more stable pressure cycles and minimizes pump "short-cycling," directly preventing motor burnout and extending equipment lifespan. 

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade epoxy powder finish, the MEGA-130 offers superior oxidation resistance. Equipped with a 1-1/4” Stainless Steel lead-free connector, this CE and ISO 9001 certified unit provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free solution for critical high-pressure applications.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-130 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Fire systems, water jets, and water machining (22.5L per minute flow rate applications)
  • Large-scale residential and commercial booster pump systems

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : What makes the water connector on the MEGA-130 safe for commercial use, and what is the tank's flow rate?

The MEGA-130 features a stainless steel water connector that is completely lead-free and chemical-free, ensuring safety for drinking water. It provides a 22.5L per minute flow rate.

Q2 : Does the MEGA-130 use a larger piping connection to accommodate higher commercial flow?

Yes, models of this size upgrade to a massive 1-1/4 inch 304 Stainless Steel connector, allowing for high-volume commercial output while remaining completely lead-free,
 

Q3 : Does the MEGA-130 require regular maintenance?

No. The MEGA-PLUS series is designed to ensure the water system works efficiently and saves energy with no maintenance required. The 100% nitrogen factory pre-charge also helps prevent the air loss and temperature fluctuations typical in standard air-filled tanks.
